name: Beacon
description: The capital of Arpad, built inside the ancient Lake of Dragon's Fall.

name: Vanderhold
description: The starting point of the campaign and the largest port in the Confederation of Free Cities.

name: Anchorhorn
description: A southern port in the Kingdom of Lyth, on the beaches of Anchorhorn many a ship at sea was once built. Anchorhorn would be considered a central ship building hub of the world.

name: Caelmarisport
description: The capital city and major port for the Kingdom of Essia.

name: Castleforge
description: Capital city for the Northern Dwarven Enclave and an unparalleled mountain fortress.

name: Aspengeld
description: Forest capital and ancient home to the Elves of Ostirose.

name: Esemere
description: A huge trading port and the bridge between the trade networks of the west and east coasts of Ostirose.

name: Fang Cove
description: The second largest port of the Sundrin Empire and a bustling hub of trade from all over Trioka.

name: Foundleinfall
description: An ancient city once part of the Magisterium, long since found and inhabited by Orcs and Giants.

name: Freehold
description: The far out-of-the-way home for smugglers, shady types, and degenerate pirates of every variety.

name: Lastport
description: Last harbor of the Confederation of Free Cities in the Bay of Lyth before passing into the northern territories.

name: Oasimere
description: The lifeblood of the trade network through the central desert, a trade hub city built around an oasis.

name: Tranquil Valley
description: A major farming and luxury hub of the Confederation built on the border of grassland and desert savannah.

name: Hourglass
description: A major trade route city and market district for the Confederation of Free Cities.

name: Westhaven
description: A major protected port on the stormy western coast.

name: Stormcliff
description: Capital of the Southern Dwarven Enclave and protected port on the stormy western coast.

name: The Nest
description: Ancient home of dragons and only major port on the southern coast of the Draconic Territories.

name: Oasirath
description: The capital of the Kingdom of the Wastes, a glimpse into the harsh realities of the desert.

name: SunDrak
description: A joint venture city built by the Orcs and Giants in celebration of their alliance, now the capital of the Sundrin Empire.

name: Aurelion's Reach
description: Once the second largest and possibly greatest city in Essia, now a scarred shadow of its former glory, colloquially known by its local inhabitants as Aurelion's Scar.

name: Preservation
description: The desiccated corpse of the once beautiful capital city of the Magisterium.

name: Outreach
description: One of the largest cities in the Wildlands, built in the shadow of the ruined Hexahedron.

name: Dawnguard
description: The fortress city and last major hub of the dwarves before exiting their domain.

name: Riverscrown
description: The capital city of the Kingdom of Lyth, where three great rivers merge into one.

name: Rosewood
description: An ancient battleground between Lyth and Essia, the town growing here is a testament to human perseverance.

name: Crownhill
description: In the contested hills of the Kingdom of Essia, once part of the Kingdom of Lyth, this city is said to sit like a crown above the rolling hills.

name: Rivercross
description: A major river crossing and river tradehub on the Westfork River.

name: Mountpass
description: This city is the northernmost major city on the western side of the Confederation of Free Cities.

name: Shadowstone
description: Once a small quarry town, now a bustling center of trade and commerce on the northern trade route.

name: Newhaven
description: The largest population center and a vital population hub, housing much of the labor that works the many farms and orchards in the surrounding lush valleys.

name: Pleasant Valley
description: One of the most lush and garden-filled cities in all of Ostirose.

name: Desert's Edge
description: A city in the Confederation of Free Cities grown out like a practical wall against the harsh southern desert.

name: Portsmith
description: One of the oldest and most noble harbor cities in the Kingdom of Lyth.

name: Athran Point
description: A Major fortress city protecting a vitally populated and resource heavy peninsula in the Kingdom of Essia.

name: Whitewake
description: Northmost harbor in Ostirose, often frozen solid in the winter and excessible only by the northern road.

name: Cape Saffar
description: The Kingdom of Arpad's only major port city.

name: North Castleport
description: The largest military garrison and fortified port city in Lyth.

name: Foreharrow
description: Often called the metropolis at the forest gate, one of the largest cities in Essia and sitting in the eves of the great forest which covers much of Essia.

name: Centerpoint
description: Named for its uniquely central position in the continent.

name: Bayview Landing
description: Once a part of the now defunct Kingdom of the Bay, this city is a major port closest to the Lyth bay in the Kingdom of Lyth.

name: Frosthall
description: The northern most major city in the Kingdom of Arpad.

name: Ganymede
description: The second largest city in the Kingdom of Arpad and major trading hub. Sitting just off the coast of Lake Ganymede.

name: Druidian's Rest
description: Deep in the Ironwood Forest is the home of Druids and Woodland elves alike.

name: Dragon Isle
description: A major port isle just off the coast of the Draconic Territories, a massive and bustling trade hub of activity.

name: Desert's Mouth
description: The largest harbor in the Kingdom of the Wastes and northernmost major city in the region.

name: Booty Bay
description: The largest port for ruffians, pirates, and smugglers in the world. Near the far edge of the world on the underbelly of the least travelled kingdom, is the largest and most sought after escape for pirates, thieves, and criminals of all kind.

name: Throgarthrum
description: The Sundrin Empire's major production hub for its most valuable trade resources. Here large stockpiles of medicines, venoms, and other jungle cocktails are produced, as well as being a major hub for the harvesting of bloodwood bark.

name: Ogrilswake
description: Major military port for the Sundrin Empire.

name: Krakensmaw
description: Southernmost Major Harbor city in the Sundrin Empire, said to be shaped like a kraken's maw and a home for the less than reputable, a type the Sundrin Empire has always been wecome to trade. Even use, when the opportunity arises.

name: Slumber Hall
description: The second largest city in the Draconic Territories, a hollowed out hill in an ancient forest valley said to once be the nest of a massive dragon.

name: Eternal Valley
description: An ancient valley between the two oldest mountain ranges, said to once be the birthplace of the first dragons.

name: Lakefall
description: Lakefall is the largest adventurer enclave built in the ruins of the Magisterium's city of Reconciliation. The town is named for the great city sinking into the lake before it.

name: Anchor Point
description: Standing at the ragged edge of the world, once a holding of the Sundrin Empire, this port is now a haven for pirates, smugglers, and outlaws of all kind. It now survives as a lawless harbor between jungle, ruin, and the sea.

name: Last Refuge
description: Enduring behind timber, moat, and stone stands the northernmost settlement in the wildlands. When winter deepens and the dead gather, this hard frontier city becomes the final sanctuary between civilization and the ruin beyond.

name: Urdred's Shadow
description: Under the shadow of an ancient fortress from the height of the Magisterium, in the harsh winters and deadly wildlands, a city of adventurers has arisen.

name: Bayview Castle
description: Once part of the now defunct Kingdom of the Bay, this castle city holds the westernmost territory of the Kingdom of Lyth.

name: Constantine
description: A thriving storehouse city between the mountains of the Dwarven Enclave and the Great Lake Ganymede.

name: Southport
description: One of the smaller major cities in Essia, full of explorers, cartographers, and adventurers. Being so far from the capital has made this place resonate with an air of more freedom.

name: Zugmurah
description: The central market city of the Sundrin Empire, deep in the jungles, safe from the coasts, this city is the center of all of the Sundrin Empire's internal trade networks.
